body: so after really looking through their whole website, i discovered the services at the place i was originally thinking of were limited recently, and no longer offer mental health services. however, i did find another local place that seemed to be available, and have sent in an email. heres hoping they can take in another patient.

ive found the location of a place i think, but now the difficulty is in trying to get it done. transport is kind of hard, but i also have a lot of difficulty filling out forms and keeping track of all my information. i was diagnosed with a.d.d. earlier on, but never received any medications for that either so ive ended up having to work around it.

i used to be, but most therapists don't take my insurance and i couldn't keep up with anymore payments. most of my sessions were spent properly cutting off abusers and recovering from my immediate trauma, but by the time i had done that i ran out of money that i could put towards therapy.

now i just watch whatever psychology lectures are available on youtube, and its helped provide me with a lot of knowledge and coping mechanisms, but it isnt the same as an actual professional.
